name: Monimal Light
description: Minimal monochrome light canvas with crisp white cards, blush-gray accent and sharp corners.
custom_css: html[data-theme-mode='light'] .text-white:not(.cta):not([class*='bg-red-']) { color: var(--heading) !important; } html[data-theme-mode='light'] .text-neutral-300, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .text-neutral-400 { color: var(--muted) !important; } html[data-theme-mode='light'] .bg-white\/5, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .bg-white\/10, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .bg-black\/30, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .bg-black\/40, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .bg-black\/50, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .bg-black\/60 { background-color: var(--input-bg) !important; } html[data-theme-mode='light'] .border-white\/5, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .border-white\/10, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .border-white\/15, html[data-theme-mode='light'] .border-white\/20 { border-color: var(--border) !important; }
